comment: The LHR’s value may be framed primarily through digital access by individuals and providers. People without digital identity, devices, literacy, connectivity, or stable residence may be excluded.

public.text: The LHR’s value may be framed primarily through digital access by individuals and providers. People without digital identity, devices, literacy, connectivity, or stable residence may be excluded.
public.suggestedRevision: Require assisted access, authorised representatives, accessible formats, non-digital alternatives, multilingual support, low-bandwidth channels, and processes for people without foundational digital identity.
